summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community include proposals for integrating Alibaba Cloud authentication into the REST Catalog and clarifying the uniqueness of live manifest entries by file path. Additionally, there are ongoing conversations about enhancing Iceberg Materialized Views and the potential deprecation of equality deletes in Iceberg V4.
highlights: Integration of Alibaba Cloud auth type for REST catalog
Clarification on uniqueness of live manifest entries by file path
Potential deprecation of equality deletes in Iceberg V4
